description.value: You spew caustic chemicals in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[12d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area with a basic Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Once activated, Gunk Spray can't be used again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge be used]]{1d4 rounds}.
